reporting_basis: SOLO / STANDALONE. Determined 2026-08-26 by matching the total assets this dataset records against the balance sheets in the bank's own annual report. Evidence: FY2025 total assets of 761,604m match the figure under this report's 'Balance Sheet' (solo) heading; 767,225m is the consolidated total.
notes: annual_reports/EBL archive covers all 15 years 2011-2025 with no gaps. Complete Q4/year-end coverage for all 15 years achieved from just three annual reports' embedded multi-year highlights tables: the 2015 report's 'Five-Year Progression of EBL' (2011-2015), the 2020 report's 'Five-Year Progression'/'Horizontal Analysis' (2016-2020), and the 2025 report's 'Five-year Progression of Financials' (2021-2025). These are unusually detailed tables (balance sheet, income statement, capital, asset quality, efficiency ratios all in one place), giving this bank one of the most complete datasets researched so far. Q1/Q2(Half-Yearly)/Q3 unaudited interim data has now been backfilled for 2017-2026 (30 quarters, all Solo/Standalone basis, sourced directly from ebl.com.bd's /quarterly-reports and /financial-reports archives) — see the 'unaudited_quarterly_financial_statements' entries below for the full per-year source list. 2011-2016 interim PDFs were located and confirmed live on the site (~18 more quarters) but were not parsed this pass; this is a time-boxing gap only, not a source-availability gap — see the 'not_yet_parsed' entry below for the exact URLs to resume from. The 2026-vintage filings (Q1 and Half-Yearly) use a different, fuller 24-page 'Condensed Consolidated and Separate Financial Statements' template than 2011-2025's compact 2-page press-release format, and this new template's Solo-section font has a pdftotext extraction bug (digit glyphs mis-map, e.g. '1'<->'L', '5'<->'s', '0'<->'O') — those two files' figures were sourced via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) of the same PDF pages instead, cross-validated three independent ways (see 2026_Q1.json/2026_Q2.json period_note for full detail). A genuine one-time restatement was found affecting FY2023 year-end figures specifically: every 2024-vintage interim filing's 31-Dec-2023 comparative column shows total_equity=BDT 39,767m and fixed_assets=BDT 8,517m, vs this dataset's existing 2023_Q4.json (sourced from the FY2025 annual report's five-year table) showing total_equity=BDT 37,484m and fixed_assets=BDT 5,994m — see 2024_Q1.json's period_note for the full reconciliation (total_liabilities matches exactly, isolating the gap to equity/fixed-asset classification). A separate, much smaller (~0.12% of total assets) comparative gap was found for FY2017 only, isolated similarly. Neither existing Q4 file was edited to 'fix' either discrepancy, per project rule. A recurring seasonal pattern was also found: EBL's paid-up capital jumps between Q1 and Q2 in 8 of the 10 years checked (bonus share issue + AGM dividend, consistently landing in Q2/Apr-Jun), with only 2018 and 2020 as gap years (2020 plausibly COVID-related) — see insights.json.

Q3 2026 not yet due as of the 2026-08-26 retrieval date. These two filings use a new, fuller 24-page template (first seen this vintage) whose Solo-section font has a pdftotext digit-extraction bug; figures were sourced via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) of the same underlying PDF pages instead and cross-validated three ways (internal P&L/BS arithmetic identities, exact match against 2025_Q4.json's comparative column, and Q1-PAT + discrete-Q2-PAT = H1-cumulative-PAT reconciliation between the two filings). This is also the only vintage where NPL%/classified-loans are disclosed in the interim statement itself (a 'Classification status of loans' note not present in the 2011-2025 compact template) — hence npl_pct/classified_loans are populated only for 2026_Q1/Q2 in this dataset's interim series. 31-Dec-2025 comparative cross-checks exactly against 2025_Q4.json in both filings.
